# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report a suspected security problem in ProphOS **privately**, by email to
**[support@oversitecp.com](mailto:support@oversitecp.com)**, with **"Security"** at the start of
the subject.

Please do **not** open a public issue, start a discussion, or use the in-app
**Report an issue…** for a security problem.

Tell us:

- the ProphOS version (**Administer › About**) and whether it came from the Microsoft Store or the
  signed download;
- your Windows version;
- what you found and what an attacker could do with it;
- how to reproduce it, as simply as you can.

Please do not include real programme data.

## What happens next

We will acknowledge your report within five working days, keep you told of progress, and let you
know when a fix is released. We ask that you give us reasonable time to fix the problem before you
disclose it. We are glad to credit you in the release notes if you wish.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made in the latest release. Please keep ProphOS up to date: the Microsoft Store
does this for you, and the signed download updates itself unless your administrator has turned
that off.

## Checking a download

Every installer attached to a release has a `.sha256` file beside it, and is signed by
OVERSITE PTE. LTD.. Check both before running it.
